source.name: archives.yotsubasociety.org (pages in 4chan's own markup)
source.short-desc: The subset of the Yotsuba Society mirror saved as 4chan's own HTML rather than the classic Futaba template.
source.capture: The ~14% of the Yotsuba Society mirror saved as 4chan's own markup -- postContainer wrappers with data-utc timestamps -- rather than the classic Futaba template the rest uses. Read by chan-html; fybertech-html skips these and this skips fybertech-html's, so both run over the same staged tree without double-counting. Unlike the classic pages these carry real UTC epochs, so their timestamps are second-accurate rather than minute-precision New-York wall time. Staged by the archives-yotsubasociety-org source; nothing to prepare here.
